revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, local-only, replacement candidate, later converted into a transparent 768x768 PNG
Asset name: achievement_medal_postcards_tier_003
Primary request: Regenerate one premium collectible postcard achievement medal for tier 3, BLUE rank. Based on the Chinese title concept "你也有点可爱" and the joke that material gifts help a little. The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows or gradients.
Subject: exactly one centered circular medal. The central character MUST be an anthropomorphic postcard/envelope mascot, not a foot: a flat rectangular ivory postcard or envelope body with rounded corners, visible envelope fold lines, tiny cartoon arms, tiny simple legs, expressive face, soft blush. No toes, no foot shape, no shoe silhouette. Tier 3 gag: the postcard mascot blushes while hugging a small blank gift box and pretending not to care, with a smug shy face; gift box has no text or logo.
Medal border: BLUE rank, third visual level: cobalt and sky-blue enamel circular ring with silver trim, small blue gems, refined side clasps and small elegant ornaments. No giant wings yet, but more refined than green.
Style/medium: polished 3D-like mobile game collectible, glossy enamel and metal, cute humorous center postcard mascot, crisp small-UI readability, same family as the new TripPet medals.
Composition/framing: one centered medal only, full object visible, generous padding, central rectangular postcard/envelope mascot inside circular core.
Lighting/mood: bright glossy highlights, bashful comedy.
Color palette: cobalt blue and sky blue border, silver trim, ivory postcard mascot, pale gift box; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no foot, no toes, no shoe, no sock, no paw, no animal, no human, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no suitcase, no money pile, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
